messages: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with his work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.

#p229#, the town clerk, asked me to greet #b#p206##k, a resident of the town. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the townspeople is a given, right?\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I greeted #p206#, a resident of #m10001000#. I have a feeling we're going to get along great!
name: First Greeting with Bruce, the Town Resident
